Game Overview

In The Flipper, the core idea is straightforward: dive into The Flipper, where pinball meets high-speed chaos. Hit the speeding red ball before time runs out while dodging unexpected bombs. Quick reflexes and strategic shots are your allies as levels grow tougher. Can you master this thrilling blend of timing and skill?
